headline.en: Alejandro Balde has decided to stay. He is not first choice on the left
headline.es: Alejandro Balde ha decidido quedarse. No es titular en la izquierda

summary.en: Alejandro Balde has decided to stay at Barcelona until 2028 after being left out of the Elche squad and after Flick discussed him in public. La Vanguardia reported that he asked for minutes to show he can start again. Joao Cancelo and Xavi Espart are currently ahead of him on the left. Interest from English clubs does not change that unless a bid arrives.
summary.es: Balde se queda hasta 2028 despues de Elche y de las palabras de Flick. La Vanguardia conto que pidio minutos. Cancelo y Espart van por delante.

body.en: The Balde week had several public chapters in three days. Mendes was in the building. Flick opened an exit door in a press conference. Balde was left out of Elche. Comments followed on television. A private conversation then ended with Balde staying on a deal that already ran to 2028. That sequence damaged the relationship even if the contract remains. Flick now has Cancelo as the experienced option and Espart as the promoted option. Balde is the third name unless he wins the next month on the training pitch. Selling him would still require a club that pays. Keeping him requires Flick to use him. Neither thing happened on Saturday. The useful version is narrower than the soap opera. Left-back is a three-man conversation. Rayo attack that channel. The eleven on Monday will say which risk Flick prefers, not which player has won the job for the season. English interest is only a story if a bid is lodged before the window shuts. Until then it is background.

headline.en: Joao Cancelo is registered after leaving Al Hilal as a free agent
headline.es: Joao Cancelo esta inscrito despues de salir libre del Al Hilal

summary.en: Joao Cancelo is now on the Liga list after terminating his contract with Al Hilal. Culemania grouped him with Anthony Gordon, Karim Adeyemi and Rodri as the four summer arrivals already registered. Barcelona used the return to the 1:1 salary rule to complete those signings. Cancelo is the experienced left-sided option Flick did not give to Balde in Elche.
summary.es: Cancelo ya esta en la lista de Liga. Culemania lo agrupa con Gordon, Adeyemi y Rodri. El Barca uso el 1:1 para cerrarlos.

body.en: Cancelo's paperwork lagged the other three because of the Saudi termination, not because Flick was unsure. Once it cleared, the left side became a three-man conversation rather than a two-man experiment. He can play full-back or step into midfield late, as he did against Athletic. That versatility is the point of signing a senior player on a free while promoting Espart. It is also why Balde's minutes are no longer automatic. Registration does not pick the eleven for Rayo. It only means Flick can name Cancelo without asking LaLiga for another exception. The 1:1 return is what made Gordon, Adeyemi, Rodri and Cancelo sit on the same sheet. Without that rule, this conversation does not exist. With it, Flick has too many left-sided options for one starting place and not enough recovered midfield minutes. That imbalance is the real squad story of the weekend, not the photograph from the medical.

headline.en: Gordon's first start lasted 80 minutes and produced no goal or assist
headline.es: El primer once de Gordon duro 80 minutos y no tuvo gol ni asistencia

summary.en: Anthony Gordon made his first Barcelona start against Athletic Club and played 80 minutes. Goal and SPORT recorded three recoveries, five duels won from nine, three completed dribbles and two shots. He did not score or assist. Flick signed him as a high-press runner after Raphinha's absences last season. Adeyemi replaced him late.
summary.es: Gordon hizo su primer once ante el Athletic y jugo 80 minutos. Tres recuperaciones, cinco duelos de nueve, tres regates y dos tiros. Sin gol ni asistencia.

body.en: Gordon arrived from Newcastle for 70 million plus add-ons with the brief to restore the press and the sprint Barcelona lost when Raphinha kept missing games. One start is a small sample. The Athletic numbers show he can win the ball and keep it under a press. They do not show the final action that fee will eventually be judged on. Adeyemi's Elche start means the left is a contest rather than a coronation. Against Rayo the choice is tactical. Gordon if Flick wants the press trigger from the flank. Adeyemi if he wants a straight run in behind a low block. Spanish desks have already written that the Elche bench surprised Gordon. That only becomes a dressing-room problem if Flick leaves the conversation unspoken. The honest version is that both were bought to cover Raphinha and to give the first line a different runner. Using both before the Champions League list begins is how you keep that honest. Leaving one unused for three weeks is how the fee becomes a grievance.
